$Comment: What Christmas Eve pays, once each Christmas. The Christmas Ornament with the year on it is not here:
it is the quest's own first Claim row, whose StackNameArg @run names it for the year's run.
The first roll always pays Christmas Coins, festival tokens and a little of what Santa had left over:
two Gingerbread Cookies and a Hot Cocoa. Its Cue plays the moment Christmas_Eve_Delivered
(FeedbackMoments/SeasonsOfOrbis/), the season's celebration, as the pay is collected; this table pays
only Christmas Eve, once a year, so the cue never repeats. The second roll is a chance on top; Chance
is a percent from 0 to 100. Favor rides the quest's own Rewards.
Name: Christmas_Eve_Pay
